title: VTG Ginny Doll 8 inch Skating Fun 1984 in Original Box - Poseable Vogue NIB
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The VTG Ginny Doll 8 inch Skating Fun 1984 in Original Box is a vintage fashion doll by Vogue. This poseable vinyl doll features blonde hair, straight hair, green eyes, and a light complexion. The set includes an outfit, doll, brochure, and receipt, all packaged in the original box. The doll is 8 inches in length and width, perfect for children aged 3 and up. This collectible doll from 1984 is ideal for all occasions and showcases a theme of fashion and beauty. Made in Hong Kong, this Vogue doll is a nostalgic addition to any doll collection.
